title: Define article wire format types in usenet-ipfs-core
description:
Define the Rust structs and enums that represent a Usenet article as stored in IPFS. Includes: ArticleHeader (per RFC 5536 mandatory fields), ArticleBody (text, UTF-8), Article (header + body), and the canonical byte representation used for CID computation. Artifact: src/article.rs in usenet-ipfs-core.

Acceptance:
- Article, ArticleHeader, ArticleBody types compile with no warnings
- RFC 5536 mandatory headers (From, Date, Message-ID, Newsgroups, Subject, Path) are typed fields
- Additional headers stored as Vec<(String, String)> in declared order
- Unit test: roundtrip from parsed headers to canonical bytes and back
